attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The empty-string guard (IsNullOrWhiteSpace) was replaced with a null check on settings, so any tenant that has the module enabled but no PixelId/TrackingID/ContainerID configured will now get broken/empty analytics scripts injected into every page head, whereas previously nothing was rendered."}

reason: The empty-string guard (IsNullOrWhiteSpace) was replaced with a null check on settings, so any tenant that has the module enabled but no PixelId/TrackingID/ContainerID configured will now get broken/empty analytics scripts injected into every page head, whereas previously nothing was rendered.
